evidence.sawLive: super chill at dusk, lit-up ground fountains and trees wrapped in string lights with the pearl chimney behind it all. not crowded in the pic, just a few people plus a kid and dog by the spray, and the caption says free to walk but $12 tacos if you cave.

items.title: river walk, 20 mins max
items.what: stone bridge, trees lit purple + green, boat with red lights down the water. go at dusk, walk a loop, don't eat down here — eat at pearl after per lena + gabe.
items.whyYou: you love night stuff that photographs well, lena hates it but admits dusk is worth it.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here
